verdict.rationale: Windmill is a developer platform with built-in AI features (AI agent steps, AI generation), so a data-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement about AI training use of customer data or any opt-out control. Self-hosting and variable encryption are adjacent features, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
